title: Cover Design: Case Bound and Educational Publications
slide_intent: Teach designers to let a book title carry the cover and to use illustration only where it helps the reader understand the subject.
strategic_value: NASA can vary the expression of educational and case-bound books while preserving a clear introduction to each subject.
demonstration: Space Mathematics places a restrained title over an open field. Photography in Space uses slanted lettering against black. A larger Apollo 11 cover pairs oversized serif type with drawn portraits.
practical_value: Compare the title-only and illustrated examples when deciding how much imagery a book needs. Check whether the binding material can reproduce the agency mark.
